title: Cem Karsan Says You Can Bet on a Big Drop Without Shorting a Thing
speaker: Cem Karsan (Kai Volatility) with Jamal Chandler

macro_themes.view: Markets are being proactively supported into the midterms; the natural course is lower.
A runaway bond market and currency stress (euro, French bonds) lead to a Treasury crisis, after which authorities deploy QE at scale and a stock-buying sovereign wealth fund.
A steep, volatile 25-40%+ decline in a narrow window within ~9 months can be played asymmetrically with options instead of shorting.

calls.condition: Market pulled higher into the midterms, then a steep 25-50% decline within ~9 months
calls.reason: Leverage, malinvestment and a bond-market crisis; authorities will step away after midterms and use the crisis for QE. Jamal sees only 2-5% downside.
calls.quote: I'm telling you not only that that this is a a big decline. I'm telling you also that it's a very short uh narrow window.

calls.reason: Runaway train in the bond market with 10y ~5.3%; a Treasury market crisis is coming.
calls.quote: a treasury market crisis is coming

notes: Guest is Cem Karsan (transcript garbles to 'Jim Caron', 'Kai Wealth'). No date stated; listing approx used. ES short-term 'bullish' reflects the agreed rally into midterms. Crash magnitude given as 25-40% / 25-50% in next 9 months; no index level target. TLT used for bond-price view.
